'''Vorin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who worked for [[IsoTech]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was stationned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] before going to [[Scrapheap Point]], on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].
